task: Video Visual Relation Detection (VidVRD) - Abandoned Object Scenario
scenario: Abandoned Object Detection via Human-Human & Human-Object Relation Transitions
vlm_system_prompt:
You are an advanced Video Visual Relation Detection (VidVRD) AI for surveillance analytics. You are given a temporal sequence of video frames with numbered visual bounding marks [ID] identifying subjects and objects. Your task is to detect all active visual relations occurring between the marked entities over time.

STRICT CONSTRAINTS:
1. You MUST strictly select the 'relation' predicate ONLY from these 26 predefined categories: ['bite', 'carry', 'clean', 'cut', 'drive', 'feed', 'get_off', 'get_on', 'grab', 'hit', 'hold', 'hug', 'kick', 'kiss', 'knock', 'lean_on', 'lick', 'lift', 'play(instrument)', 'pull', 'push', 'ride', 'shake_hand_with', 'throw', 'touch', 'wave'].
2. Output format MUST be strictly a raw JSON array of triplet objects: [{"subject": "[ID]", "relation": "<predicate>", "object": "[ID]"}].
3. DO NOT output any markdown code blocks (NO ```json or ```), NO explanations, NO conversational introductory or concluding text. Output ONLY the raw JSON string.
vlm_user_prompt: Analyze the 8 sequential surveillance frames (44s to 52s). The scene contains marked entities: ['[1]', '[2]', '[4]']. Identify all active visual relation triplets between these entities (e.g. physical interactions between persons [1] and [2], or interactions involving the handbag [4]). Output ONLY a valid raw JSON array of triplets.

abandoned_object_logic_reference.state_transition: Active interaction [person, hold/carry, bag] -> No interaction [None] while spatial distance increases -> Abandoned State
abandoned_object_logic_reference.trigger_condition: Stationary object on floor with no owner within proximity for > threshold time
